S4Drive 0.3.0 brings Notes: a Markdown notebook with folders that saves as you type and syncs to your other devices like any other file. Your notes stay plain `.md` files in the `Notes` folder of your sync folder, so any editor can open them.

## ✨ New
- **Notes**: write notes in Markdown, organise them in folders and subfolders, and switch between the raw text and a formatted preview. Create, rename, move and delete notes and folders; a deleted note can be brought back with Undo.
- **Saved and synced, separately**: every edit is saved on your device within a couple of seconds, and the status shows whether it has reached your other devices yet. **Sync** sends it right away.
- **No silent overwrites**: if a note was changed on another device or in another editor at the same time, both versions are kept, the other one as a conflict copy.
- **Backup**: one click saves all your notes and folders into a ZIP file on your computer. `s4drive-cli notes backup`, `verify-backup` and `extract-backup` create, check and unpack such a file without the app or the cloud.
- **Missing sync folder**: if the sync folder or its `Notes` folder is deleted or moved outside the app, syncing stops instead of deleting your files on other devices. A warning lets you restore the data from the server or confirm the deletion everywhere.
- **Logs tab**: choose how detailed the log is, copy its path or open its folder. Logs take up to 150 MB and are kept outside the temporary folder, so they survive a restart.

## 🛠 Improvements
- A file renamed while S4Drive was not running keeps its identity and is synced as a rename, not as a new file plus a delete.
- A delete retried after a network error is recorded once and no longer replaces the same delete made by another device.

## 🐛 Fixes
- A file created at the old path of a renamed file is no longer uploaded as a new version of the renamed file.
- An edit saved just before a rename now goes to the renamed file instead of a file under the old name.
- A file renamed and then moved before the next sync lands in its final place, and a file renamed while it was still uploading keeps its new name.
- **Restore data from server**, restoring a version and resolving a conflict now wait for a running sync to finish instead of failing with "Sync is already running".
- The yellow warning on the tray icon goes away once the problem is resolved.

## ⬆️ Upgrading
- Nothing to do: the bucket format is unchanged, so 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 devices can sync the same bucket. The `Notes` folder syncs to 0.2.0 devices as ordinary files.
